errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays three tiers of LLMs, labeled as Tier-1, Tier-2, and Tier-3, ordered from left to right.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis in the figure is unlabeled. The description hallucinates the existence of three labeled tiers, likely misinterpreting information from the provided paper caption which is not visually represented on the chart's axes.

errors.text_span: The tick labels are spaced at increments of 5%, starting at 0% and ending at 60%.
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the vertical axis are at 0, 20, 40, and 60. The increment is 20%, not 5%.

errors.text_span: The bars for Tier-1 range in color from green to purple and have approximate heights of 55%, 61%, 49%, and 41%, respectively, while the bars for Tier-2 range in color from light blue to gray and have approximate heights of 48.83%, 46.36%, 43.79%, and 40.87%, and the bars for Tier-3 range in color from dark blue to dark gray and have approximate heights of 54.83%, 48.28%, 27.22%, and 24.64%
errors.evidence: This entire description of the bars is incorrect because it is based on the hallucinated 'Tiers'. It incorrectly groups the 12 individual bars and misreports many of their values. For example, the first four bars have actual values of 61.09, 48.28, 24.64, and 60.72, not '55%, 61%, 49%, and 41%'.

errors.text_span: All bars are of equal height
errors.evidence: The bars clearly represent different values and have visibly different heights, ranging from 24.64% to 61.09%. Stating they are of equal height is a fundamental misrepresentation of the chart.
